tool.title: Fatty Liver Index · Bedogni 2006
tool.formula: L = 0,953 × ln(triglicerídeos) + 0,139 × IMC + 0,718 × ln(GGT) + 0,053 × cintura − 15,745; FLI = 100 × exp(L)/(1 + exp(L)). Triglicerídeos em mg/dL, GGT em U/L, IMC em kg/m² e cintura em cm.
sources: Bedogni et al. 2006 · Fatty Liver Index

primarySources.access: Full publisher open-access HTML: original coefficients, ln definition, BMI derivation, 18–75 population, limitations read.
primarySources.scope: FLI logistic equation; waist cm, BMI kg/m², triglycerides mg/dL, GGT U/L. No individual steatosis/fibrosis diagnosis claimed.

tool.limits: Índice derivado em adultos. Não diagnostica esteatose nem avalia fibrose. Revisão clínica independente não realizada.
sourceLimitEvidence: Synthetic numerical inputs only; no patient data.
Decimal conformance is not independent clinical validation, diagnostic approval or professional translation approval.
FLI software input bounds can generate mathematically valid stress cases outside a plausible clinical phenotype; no applicability is claimed for those combinations.
Tanaka estimates population sodium excretion, not individual intake. NaCl equivalent conversion does not establish ingestion or dietary advice.
Tanaka publisher full text was unavailable; original indexed abstract coefficients and primary study unit reproduction were read.
Sampson direct-LDL path is verified as an arithmetic extension; 2021 calibration uses Sampson-estimated LDL and is not claimed to validate this extension clinically.
TG800 bound is supported for the Sampson2020 LDL equation; sdLDL estimation and other bounds require population/method review.
No claims about all global formulas, third-party integrations, clinical performance, UI multilingual rendering or deployment are made by this module-only audit.

methodEditionEvidence.policies: Age18–75 reflects study population. Other input limits are technical software policies, not clinically validated phenotype bounds. No diagnostic cutoff/category is generated.

versionEvidence.access: Full publisher equation, limitations and rights section read
versionEvidence.rights: Article CC-BY-2.0 with attribution; no complete article, image or clinical data bundled.
